svg.text: Partner entry map · fourteen disciplines · all 56 programme entries
Start with the artefact or capability your team contributes, then agree its input/output and evidence boundary.
ARCHITECTURE DOCUMENTED · DELIVERY AND PHYSICAL QUALIFICATION REMAIN SCOPED
Teal: neuromorphic work · blue: shared interfaces/evidence · ochre: circuit/physical work. Colour identifies a domain, not readiness.
